player_prompt.intro:
I bɛ dasɔrɔ Blackjack kɔnɔ dealer.
N ka kɛ o bɛ wele kɛ 21 kɔfɛ, o yɛrɛ fɛ.
Anw tɔgɔ, i ca '[Hit]' kɔnɔ sɔrɔ kɛ, '[Stand]' kɔnɔ kɛlɛ.
J/Q/K = 10 pointu; A = 11 wa 1, ɛyɔ bɛta.
